settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.description: Everything you need to know about our organic formulations, sustainable packaging, and order fulfillment.

settings.content:
Pure Botanical Alchemy & Holistic Skin Health

We formulate our skincare with ethically harvested botanicals, cold-pressed seed oils, and bioactive ferments. Below you will find answers to frequently asked questions regarding our formulations, sustainable packaging, and shipping policies.

settings.title: What skin types are Aura Botanica formulations designed for?
settings.content: Our biocompatible formulations are designed for all skin types, including sensitive, sensitized, and barrier-compromised skin. Each product is formulated without artificial fragrances, harsh sulfates, parabens, or synthetic dyes, focusing on soothing nourishment and skin-barrier restoration.

settings.title: How long will it take to receive my order?
settings.content: Standard domestic shipping typically delivers within 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping options (1 to 2 business days) are available at checkout. All orders include end-to-end tracking so you can follow your delivery in real time.

settings.title: Do you offer complimentary shipping?
settings.content: Yes! We offer complimentary standard shipping on all domestic orders over $75.00. Your free shipping progress is automatically calculated in your cart drawer as you add formulations.

settings.title: Are your ingredients vegan and cruelty-free?
settings.content: 100% yes. Aura Botanica is certified cruelty-free. We never test on animals, nor do we source from suppliers that do. All formulations are vegan and blended using sustainably harvested botanical extracts.

settings.title: What is your return and satisfaction guarantee?
settings.content: We want you to love your skincare ritual. We offer a 30-day satisfaction guarantee on all formulations. If a product does not suit your skin, simply reach out to our concierge team at support@aurabotanica.com for an exchange or full refund.
